title: Andreas Antonopoulos - 51% Bitcoin Attack
summary: A two-minute clip of Andreas Antonopoulos explaining why a 51% attack on Bitcoin would not destroy it and what such an attack would cost. It is a succinct take on mining security.
why: HN commenters link it as a short, favorite explanation of Bitcoin's security and the sustainability of a 51% attack.

quote.text: Andreas Antonopoulos has a good take on this for Bitcoin
